text:
President Trump welcomed Lebanese President Joseph Aoun to the White House on Tuesday as Beirut seeks U.S. support amid the war with Hezbollah. It marked the first visit by a Lebanese president to the White House since 2009.

"We feel very good about Lebanon," Trump said.

text: Tropical Storm Bertha was getting stronger early Tuesday, threatening the Gulf Coast with heavy rain as its projected path sparked watches and warnings along the coastal region.

text: Arizona voters will go to the polls to choose who will take on Democratic Gov. Katie Hobbs, and key congressional districts are also holding primaries as the heated battle to control the House continues.

text: An appeals court denied former President Joe Biden's attempt to keep the Justice Department from giving a conservative think tank redacted transcripts and audio recordings of conversations with his biographer.
